profileEvidence.summary: Affectionate and playful, the Cavachon is a companion cross of the Cavalier King Charles Spaniel and Bichon Frise. It often seeks close company and may bark when ignored or bored. Toy chasing and food-search games give that playful energy an outlet, while long periods alone can be difficult.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: An affectionate, playful companion cross that seeks close company; attention-seeking barking can emerge when bored.
